faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIT Warangal JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Warangal is 14th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Tech/BE in Electrical Engineering or related fields, along with an M.Tech/ME in Power Electronics or related areas, and a valid GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post is 30 years, with age relaxation applicable as per institute norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Research Fellow position is Rs. 37,000 per month for the first two years and Rs. 42,000 per month for the third year.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the NIT Warangal JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email with all required documents attached. The specific email address will be provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Warangal is a contractual role.

faq.question: Q9. Which department is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the National Institute of Technology Warangal (NIT Warangal).

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article.
